name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-modern-glossary
title: Modern Glossary
shortDescription: A dynamic SharePoint Framework web part displaying an A-Z indexed, accordion-style glossary with alphabet navigation, in-place item management, and Active/Inactive content lifecycle control.
longDescription: A dynamic SharePoint Framework (SPFx) web part that displays glossary terms sourced from a SharePoint list in an A-Z indexed, accordion-style layout. Features include alphabet-based navigation with disabled states for empty letters, expand/collapse-all controls, free-text search across title and description, and in-place add/edit/delete item management surfaced through a gear icon visible only in page Edit mode. Content lifecycle is controlled through an Active/Inactive Status field, filtered server-side so retired terms are never sent to the browser. Perfect for IT glossaries, acronym libraries, application directories, and other structured reference content on SharePoint pages.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts are client-side components that run in the context of a SharePoint page. Client-side web parts can be deployed to SharePoint environments that support the SharePoint Framework. You can also use modern JavaScript web frameworks, tools, and libraries to build them.
